content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, with the first phase being rolled out to Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic said Claude Cowork has fully launched on mobile and desktop platforms, available to all paid plans.

For more details on Anthropic's mobile rollout of Claude Cowork, click here.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, ChatGPT Work, which is also available on iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web.
